source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check fan`s speed/number/location in BMC
1. Insert required fan on SUT
2. Power on
3. Check fan speed via BMC webpage
3. Check fan number via BMC webpage

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Check fan speed/location in BMC webpage

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sdr list 2>&1 | grep -iE "fan" ; echo ---loc---; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sel elist 2>&1 | grep -iE "fan" ; echo ---fru---; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" fru 2>&1 | grep -iE "fan"
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL ipmitool fan SDR + SEL elist + FRU fan lines so the user confirms fan speed/number/location reported by BMC matches the physical layout. No RISK (read-only).

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES. Its read-only commands can support inventory, but omit physical fan insertion, power-on and the source-required BMC webpage checks; grep text does not prove location.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED. V2 restores physical and GUI coverage but does not apply the locked rule that these human core steps make the case manual-only.

original_test_intent: Verify the required physical fan population and confirm BMC Web UI reports the correct speed, count and location mapping for those fans.
original_method: A qualified operator installs the specified fan modules, powers on the SUT, captures BMC Web UI speed/count/location fields, and reconciles each displayed fan with the owner physical map and complete read-only inventory/RPM telemetry.
manual_activity: The source requires physical fan insertion and BMC webpage inspection. A qualified operator must establish the physical mapping and capture the GUI; command-line fan data cannot substitute for either core requirement.
required_inputs: Fan modules/FRUs, expected count and physical slot/location map
Expected per-fan RPM ranges and tolerance
BMC Web UI path and exact speed/count/location fields
Safe installation/ESD/power-on procedure, operator, maintenance window and OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Do not insert/remove fan hardware while powered unless explicitly supported and approved.
Verify each module, connector and required cooling population before power-on.
Protect BMC credentials and preserve full GUI and unfiltered inventory data.
Stop on wrong fan, mapping mismatch, RPM/thermal alarm, BMC loss or unsafe access; no automatic reseat/reboot.
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete BMC/IPMI/Redfish sensor and inventory data plus RPM/thermal health.
Reconcile those records with operator-supplied installation and Web UI evidence using the supplied fan map.
Report per-fan discrepancies without claiming manual steps or issuing the verdict.
engineer_actions: Supply the physical and BMC field mapping and expected RPM/count.
Install required fans, power on and capture BMC Web UI evidence.
Confirm final cooling state and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Incomplete and overclaimed. Filtered SDR/SEL/FRU lines can corroborate sensors but do not prove physical location, installed count or BMC webpage values; SEL is not inherently a location database.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the physical installation and BMC webpage method, and capture full unfiltered sensor/inventory output with a stable owner fan-to-sensor mapping.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Physical insertion, power-on, BMC webpage speed/count/location and both one-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: RETAIN GUI AND PHYSICAL MAPPING WITH COMPLETE INVENTORY
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Label every physical fan/slot, capture BMC Web UI screenshots/export for speed/count/location, and compare them with complete sensor/inventory records and the owner mapping table.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact chassis, fan FRUs and BMC firmware/UI version.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/fan, BMC, CPLD, browser/UI and inventory-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform fan population/service documentation and BMC Web UI field specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable per-fan identity and cross-view evidence without replacing the webpage check.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No loss; filtered CLI output alone remains insufficient.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Fan map/count/RPM bands and Web UI field definition.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: FRU or sensor names may omit physical location, so mapping must come from platform documentation.

project_override_considerations: A project may define a specific population and acceptable RPMs, but must document which fans were installed and observed. It cannot infer webpage location solely from a sensor name or omit the physical/GUI steps.
expected_evidence: Fan FRU/count/slot map, RPM ranges, BMC field map and approval
Physical installation record/photos and power-on status
Timestamped BMC Web UI speed/count/location evidence for every fan
Complete mapped sensor/inventory/RPM/thermal/SEL evidence and final health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item, procedure and criterion consistently target fan speed/count/location in BMC Web UI. The duplicated step number is editorial and does not change semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The missing fan map, RPM ranges and GUI fields are project inputs. With qualified installation and GUI access, the manual core can proceed.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Reject YES and grep-only location inference; retain its CLI data only as corroboration.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retain physical mapping and cross-view safeguards; change capability to MANUAL ONLY because installation and Web UI are explicit core steps.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Prevents remote sensor output from silently replacing the master source method.

review_improvement: Requires traceability from each installed fan to its BMC webpage record and restores the source's physical and GUI scope.
independent_technical_reasoning: Even if all sensor values are available over IPMI, the test asks whether the exact physical population is mapped correctly in a BMC webpage. Establishing the physical slots and observing the GUI are mandatory human activities under the locked rules, so MANUAL ONLY is correct.
